reason: The patch changes the ticker to 1 minute (cleanup.go:77) but leaves `const timeout = 9 * time.Minute` (cleanup.go:89), so the per-run limit is now nine times the cadence. Runs cannot truly overlap because `clean` is called synchronously in the loop (cleanup.go:80-81). But a run longer than 1 minute leaves a buffered tick, so the next run starts right after it, and cleanup can run back-to-back nearly nonstop.
